description: This file implements a command for searching documentation within the openclaw project, including functions for executing search commands, parsing results, and rendering output in rich or markdown format.

classes.name: DocResult
classes.description: Type representing a documentation search result with title, link, and optional snippet.

classes.name: NodeRunner
classes.description: Type representing a command runner with command and arguments.

classes.name: ToolRunOptions
classes.description: Type for options when running a tool, including optional input and timeout.

methods.name: resolveNodeRunner
methods.description: Determines the appropriate node package runner (pnpm or npx).

methods.name: runNodeTool
methods.description: Executes a Node-based tool with timeout and optional input.

methods.name: runTool
methods.description: Runs a specified tool, using Node runner if necessary.

methods.name: extractLine
methods.description: Extracts a line starting with a specific prefix from an array of lines.

methods.name: normalizeSnippet
methods.description: Normalizes and truncates a snippet string to a maximum length.

methods.name: firstParagraph
methods.description: Extracts the first paragraph from a block of text.

methods.name: parseSearchOutput
methods.description: Parses raw search output into an array of DocResult objects.

methods.name: escapeMarkdown
methods.description: Escapes markdown special characters in a string.

methods.name: buildMarkdown
methods.description: Builds markdown formatted string from search query and results.

methods.name: formatLinkLabel
methods.description: Removes protocol from URL to create a label.

methods.name: renderRichResults
methods.description: Logs search results in a rich format using theme styling.

methods.name: renderMarkdown
methods.description: Outputs markdown string to runtime log.

methods.name: docsSearchCommand
methods.description: Main exported function to perform documentation search based on query parts.
